name.rationale: This name is not related to security related policies.

application_endpoint.description: Address of the remote application endpoint for the BeyondCorp AppConnection. Structure is [documented below](#nested_application_endpoint).
application_endpoint.rationale: This is the address of the remote application endpoint.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote application endpoint.
host.rationale: This is the hostname of the remote application endpoint. It should be either a valid IPv4 address or a fully-qualified domain name.

port.description: Port of the remote application endpoint.
port.rationale: This is crucial to establish a connection to the remote application endpoint.

region.rationale: This defines the geographical location of the AppConnection, which can have implications for data residency and latency.

display_name.description: An arbitrary user-provided name for the AppConnection.
display_name.rationale: Display name is for user convenience and does not impact security.

labels.description: Resource labels to represent user provided metadata. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are used for metadata and do not directly impact security.

type.description: The type of network connectivity used by the AppConnection. Refer to https://cloud.google.com/beyondcorp/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.appConnections#type for a list of possible values.
type.rationale: Only TCP_PROXY is allowed as the AppConnection type for compliance.

connectors.description: List of AppConnectors that are authorised to be associated with this AppConnection
connectors.rationale: This attribute associates the AppConnectors to the AppConnection and does not directly impact security.

gateway.description: Gateway used by the AppConnection. Structure is [documented below](#nested_gateway).
gateway.rationale: The gateway configuration for this AppConnection is not directly impact security policies.

app_gateway.rationale: The AppGateway name is used to identify the gateway resource.

type.description: The type of hosting used by the gateway. Refer to https://cloud.google.com/beyondcorp/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.appConnections#Type_1 for a list of possible values.
type.rationale: The type of hosting does not inherently affect security policies.

uri.rationale: The URI is used to identify the gateway resource.

ingress_port.description: (Output) Ingress port reserved on the gateways for this AppConnection, if not specified or zero, the default port is 19443.
ingress_port.rationale: The ingress port is used to identify the gateway resource. And it should not be set to a common web port.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project field is used to identify the project resource. Some organisations may have policies that restrict which projects can be used, but this is not inherently a security issue.
